title: Clean up file names

cases.name: jpeg only at the end is changed
leading spaces are part of the name
a last line with no newline is still processed

hints: Read lines with: while IFS= read -r name; do ... done   (IFS= keeps leading spaces).
name="${name,,}" lower-cases; name="${name// /_}" replaces every space.
Test the ending with [[ "$name" == *.jpeg ]] and rebuild it as "${name%.jpeg}.jpg".
For the last test add || [[ -n "$name" ]] to the while condition.
